description: Test suite for Telegram-related utility functions and parsing logic in a TypeScript project using Vitest. Includes tests for prefix stripping, target parsing, normalization, and policy resolution for Telegram groups and users.

methods.name: stripTelegramInternalPrefixes
methods.description: Removes internal Telegram prefixes from input strings.

methods.name: parseTelegramTarget
methods.description: Parses a string into a Telegram target object with chatId, messageThreadId, and chatType.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramChatId
methods.description: Normalizes and validates Telegram chat IDs, rejecting URLs and usernames.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramLookupTarget
methods.description: Converts various legacy and URL forms into standardized Telegram lookup targets.

methods.name: looksLikeTelegramTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be a valid Telegram target ID.

methods.name: resolveTelegramGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Determines whether a Telegram group or topic requires mention based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveTelegramGroupToolPolicy
methods.description: Determines allowed tools/policies for a Telegram group based on configuration.

methods.name: isNumericTelegramChatId
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a numeric Telegram chat ID.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramAllowFromEntry
methods.description: Normalizes 'allow from' entries for Telegram, handling prefixes.

methods.name: installMaybePersistResolvedTelegramTargetTests
methods.description: Sets up tests for persisting resolved Telegram targets.
